content: Following previous work, we split the training procedure to pre-training and fine-tuning stages. In pre-training stage, the speech encoder $enc_s$ is trained towards CTC objective using dataset $\mathcal {A}$, while the text encoder $enc_t$ and the decoder $dec$ are trained on MT dataset $\mathcal {M}$. In fine-tuning stage, we jointly train the model on ASR, MT, and ST tasks.
